fields.name: pap.code
fields.description: The Code field is one octet and identifies the type of PAP packet

fields.name: pap.identifier
fields.description: The Identifier field is one octet and aids in matching requests and replies.

fields.name: pap.length
fields.description: The Length field is two octets and indicates the length of the PAP packet

fields.name: pap.data
fields.description: The format of the Data field is determined by the Code field

fields.name: pap.peer_id.length
fields.description: The Peer-ID-Length field is one octet and indicates the length of the Peer-ID field

fields.name: pap.peer_id
fields.description: The Peer-ID field is zero or more octets and indicates the name of the peer to be authenticated

fields.name: pap.password.length
fields.description: The Password-Length field is one octet and indicates the length of the Password field

fields.name: pap.password
fields.description: The Password field is zero or more octets and indicates the password to be used for authentication

fields.name: pap.message.length
fields.description: The Message-Length field is one octet and indicates the length of the Message field

fields.name: pap.message
fields.description: The Message field is zero or more octets, and its contents are implementation dependent.
